thesis: Worldwide supplier of semiconductor test and burn-in solutions whose long-anticipated AI/silicon-photonics inflection arrived with a blowout Q4 FY2026 (reported 2026-07-14): record quarterly bookings of $60.7M, ~$100M effective backlog, and FY2027 revenue guidance of $130M–$150M (160–200% YoY growth) that dwarfed the ~$85M consensus. FOX-XP wafer-level burn-in systems now serve AI/data-center processors and hyperscale silicon photonics optical interconnects, while a stabilizing SiC/EV base adds $8M+ in fresh orders. The thesis is high-conviction but the risk/reward is binary: the stock trades at ~100x forward earnings with a 3.18 beta, a small revenue base, customer concentration, and execution risk against a very aggressive guide.

drivers: AEHR executes at or above the $130M–$150M FY2027 revenue guide (2.6x–3.0x FY2026)
AI/data-center processor and silicon photonics burn-in demand compounds with follow-on FOX-XP production orders
Return to solid profitability with operating leverage as revenue scales
Additional hyperscaler/AI customer wins broaden the base beyond the lead photonics customer

base_case.assumptions: AEHR delivers strong triple-digit FY2027 growth landing within the guided $130M–$150M range; AI/photonics ramps as backlog converts and SiC/EV order flow stabilizes; profitability returns but the ~100x forward multiple compresses somewhat as the story de-risks and the stock consolidates its post-print gains.

risks: FY2027 guidance proves too aggressive and revenue lands well below $130M as customer ramps slip
AI/silicon-photonics orders concentrated in a single lead customer disappoint or push out
Extreme valuation (~100x forward) and 3.18 beta amplify a sharp drawdown on any miss
Shelf registration is drawn on, diluting shareholders; patent litigation and Advantest/Teradyne competition weigh

catalysts.event: Q1 FY2027 earnings — first data point on execution against the $130M–$150M FY2027 guide
Execution vs the $130M–$150M FY2027 revenue guide (160–200% YoY growth) and backlog conversion
New AI/hyperscaler and silicon photonics customer orders (follow-on FOX-XP wafer-level burn-in wins)
SiC/EV wafer-level burn-in order flow as electric-vehicle programs re-accelerate

key_risks: Extreme valuation — ~100x forward earnings leaves no margin for execution error
Very high beta (3.18) and small revenue base make the stock exceptionally volatile
Customer concentration — AI/photonics growth leans on a lead silicon photonics customer
Ongoing patent litigation and competition from larger test peers (Advantest, Teradyne)
Mixed-securities shelf registration creates future capital-raise / dilution optionality
